content_sections.heading: RARI Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates should download and read the RARI Jobs 2026 notification PDF carefully to check vacancy details, eligibility, age limit, and application instructions. The notification also includes important dates and selection process details. The direct download link is available in the Important Links section below. Download RARI Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Young Professional (YP-II): Master's Degree in Plant Breeding and Genetics or Genetics and Plant Breeding Discipline. Experience in Laboratory and field work, Research Writing, Knowledge of computer application data collection and handling & statistical analysis. Field Assistant: Intermediate (12th Pass) in agriculture stream. Graduation in Agriculture along with experience in field research work.

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: All Posts: Maximum age is 45 years. Age relaxation for Women, SC, ST, SAP is applicable as per the rules and regulations.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for RARI Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Rajasthan Agricultural Research Institute (RARI), Jaipur for filling various temporary positions under research projects.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are available under RARI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 6 vacancies have been announced for Young Professional-II and Field Assistant posts through this recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q3. What are the posts available in this recruitment drive?
faq.answer: The available posts are Young Professional (YP-II) and Field Assistant, aimed at supporting agricultural research activities at the institute.

faq.question: Q4. What is the selection process for RARI Posts?
faq.answer: Candidates will be selected directly through a walk-in interview conducted at the designated venue on the scheduled date without any written test.

faq.question: Q5. When is the walk-in interview scheduled for RARI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled to take place on 05 October 2026 at the Directorate Office, RARI, Durgapura starting from 10:00 AM.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for Young Professional-II post?
faq.answer: Candidates selected for the Young Professional (YP-II) position will receive a fixed consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 42,000.

faq.question: Q7. What is the qualification required for the Field Assistant post?
faq.answer: Applicants for the Field Assistant post must have passed Intermediate (12th Pass) in the agriculture stream, with graduation in agriculture being an added advantage.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee required to apply for these posts?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification, making it completely free to appear for the walk-in interview process.

faq.question: Q9. What is the maximum age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all posts is set at 45 years, with necessary age relaxations applicable for reserved category candidates as per rules.

faq.question: Q10. Where should candidates report for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must report directly to the Directorate Office, Rajasthan Agricultural Research Institute (RARI), Durgapura, Jaipur, along with all required documents.
